held.why: REFUSED: 'The carriage-drive is earlier' treats it as a place the Mole passed. Line 10 only compares his tunnel to a carriage-drive owned by other animals, so this reinforces the literal reading the distractor is tagged for (en-figurative-taken-literally). Say the tunnel is only being compared to a carriage-drive.

REFUSED: Final clause 'every dance belongs to Mr Bingley' reads literally as false or confusing (Darcy danced two). It means the 'every dance' option describes Mr Bingley; say so plainly, e.g. 'danced every dance' at line 37 is about Mr Bingley.

REFUSED: 'That adds a good six miles to the way home' is not what line 30 says. The text says it 'will be a good six miles before we get round to the wooden bridge again', i.e. the detour round to the bridge is six miles, not six miles added to the journey home.

REFUSED: 'He carries kind regards and a question about the leg' misdescribes line 13: 'hopes his leg's better' is a hope, not a question, and the only question is the spirit-level. It also does not show whose leg, which is what the attribute-transfer option turns on.

REFUSED: 'What he likes about it is getting out of spellings' claims a feeling the passage does not state, and splits 'get out of spellings' off from Miss's words when line 41 has it inside the same reported sentence ('Miss said we can do that one on Monday and get out of spellings').

REFUSED: 'It tells you what they stand beneath' claims something line 9 does not say: they 'washed ... under the spout', nothing about standing. Also 'find the word under' is unquoted, so a child can read it as an instruction to look underneath; quote it ('under').
REFUSED: 'find the two things they borrow' is false: the ash-tray and baking-tin are their own things used in place of the right ones (lines 21-22), not borrowed from anyone.

REFUSED: 'Go to line 20 and find the word below' and 'notice further along' leave the cited words unquoted, so 'find the word below' reads as an instruction to look below the line. Quote them ('Below', 'further along'); content is otherwise correct.
